---
title: "About the author"
---

Erasmo Vassallo, born in 1972, is Associate Professor of Economic Statistics at the Department of Economics, Business and Statistics of the University of Palermo. 

In the current teaching programme, he teaches economic statistics, statistical models for financial markets and methods for performance evaluation in private and public services in the bachelor's and master's degree programmes in statistics. 

He is a statistician trained in the Palermo school (graduated in 1995) and, as a statistician, worked for several companies and institutions, including ISTAT (National Institute of Statistics). He began his PhD in 1998 under the guidance of Prof. Gaetano Cusimano. 

He is the author of some textbooks and many scientific articles in national and international journals. He has published numerous commentaries on statistical and economic topics in regional and national newspapers and specialized websites.

Homepage: https://www.unipa.it/persone/docenti/v/erasmo.vassallo
